observed_sequence: The disassembly contains packed HMUL2 operations, HADD2.F32 conversions of half lanes, FADD.FTZ accumulation, SHFL.DOWN warp reductions, then FP16 output conversion/store. One FFMA.FTZ is present in each template and appears in scaling/dequant setup; the product/accumulation path contains HMUL2 and FADD, not an FFMA dot-product chain.
interpretation: This supports testing FP16-rounded products followed by FP32 accumulation. M=1 and M=3 are distinct compiled templates with different instruction counts and layout, even though prior actual-input checks found row outputs invariant between them.
